content:
iPhone 18 Pro will be unveiled next week on September 9, when the all-new Pro and Pro Max models will be announced. Here are the rumored features for each model.

iPhone 18 Pro: Comprehensive upgrades in performance, camera, design and battery life

Apple's flagship iPhone 18 Pro will retain the same 6.3-inch size as last year's model, focusing on key improvements that matter most to users: performance, camera, design and battery life.

Performance: The A20 Pro is Apple's new chip that will make the iPhone more powerful than ever, perfectly timed for the Siri AI features in iOS 27. It belongs to the same chip family as the newly announced M6, signaling a major upgrade on the horizon.

Camera: The iPhone's camera system will also undergo major changes this year. Reports indicate that the main lens will adopt a brand-new module, making the camera area thicker than before, and adding a variable aperture feature that may be exclusive to the Pro Max or available on both models. The telephoto lens performance will improve due to a larger aperture, enhancing low-light photography. A new camera control button is also reportedly on the way.

Design: The iPhone 18 Pro will look very similar to its predecessor, but with several key refinements. The Dynamic Island cutout will shrink by roughly 35%, the back glass and aluminum will feature a more unified color blend, and a new flagship shade will be introduced—including deep cherry/wine red.

Battery: Thanks to the A20 Pro's improved performance and the new Apple C2 modem, the iPhone 18 Pro will deliver better battery life than ever. Battery capacity will also increase slightly.

iPhone 18 Pro Max: All of the above plus more exclusive upgrades

The iPhone 18 Pro Max will include all the features mentioned above, but with a larger 6.9-inch body. According to rumors, it will have at least one exclusive advantage, possibly up to two:

  • Larger battery capacity increase than the iPhone 18 Pro
  • Exclusive camera feature, possibly variable aperture

Apple's Pro Max models have always offered better battery life than the smaller Pro. But rumors suggest the iPhone 18 Pro Max may further extend its lead in this area.

Data leaked from regulatory filings shows the iPhone 18 Pro Max's battery capacity is roughly 10% larger than the iPhone 17 Pro Max. Combined with the performance gains from Apple's in-house chips, the Pro Max will become the ultimate choice for users seeking maximum battery life like never before.

In addition, the new variable aperture camera feature may be exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro Max. There have been conflicting reports about whether this feature will be available on both models. But Mark Gurman specifically noted in his latest newsletter that the feature will be exclusive to the Pro Max model.

Are you planning to upgrade to the iPhone 18 Pro, or are you going to skip it? Let us know in the comments.
